fields.label: Category Key
fields.description: Stable unique key used in API (e.g. approvals, leave_status). Never change after creation.

fields.label: Label (English)
fields.description: Display label shown in the mobile app (English)

fields.label: Label (Arabic)
fields.description: Display label shown in the mobile app (Arabic)

fields.label: Mandatory
fields.description: User cannot disable this category. Separate from bypass_quiet_hours.

fields.label: Default Enabled
fields.description: Whether new users start with this category enabled.

fields.label: User Configurable
fields.description: Whether the user can change this preference in the app.

fields.label: FCM Importance
fields.description: FCM delivery priority for messages in this category. Use 'high' only for time-sensitive alerts.

fields.label: Bypass Quiet Hours
fields.description: Send push even during the user's configured quiet hours. Independent of Mandatory.

fields.label: Notification Action Set
fields.description: Quick actions available in the notification. 'approve_reject' only for supported approval categories.
